thread:
jamie-cs: FYI — Cloudline Labs is running a customer demo tomorrow and asked for a temporary QPS increase for ap-southeast-1 + eu-west-1. They expect a short spike (~350 qps) during the demo, then ~120 qps sustained for ~48h. Also asked for a proxy CIDR allowlist. Renewal meeting next week so outcome matters.

nate-eng: We can provision a short-lived override. Plan: route to dedicated-pool-d1, scale to 2x, add rate-override with auto-revoke. Need exact CIDRs and confirmation of regions. @rachel-sre can you prep edge ACLs?

taylor-cs: Pinging the customer now. They provided two proxy ranges in the support ticket: `203.0.113.0/28` and `198.51.100.32/28`. Confirmed regions: ap-southeast-1, eu-west-1. They requested 48h TTL for the override.

rachel-sre: Good — those prefixes are fine. Ill stage ACLs for both regions. Suggest rate gating: burst window 5m, sustained 120 qps, emergency peak gate 350 qps. Will also require TLS SNI (pin to their hostname) for the demo. Adding latency watch and a KV hit-rate check.

ops-bot: ACL rules created (acl-id: acl-cl-8712) applied to ap-southeast-1 & eu-west-1 for tenant Cloudline Labs. Auto-revoke scheduled: 2026-03-25T15:00:00Z.

nate-eng: Pushing rate override now. Config recorded: `route: cloudline-demo; regions: [ap-southeast-1, eu-west-1]; peak_qps:350; sustained_qps:120; burst_window:300s; auto_revoke:2026-03-25T15:00:00Z; dedicated_pool:dedicated-pool-d1`. I'll tag the deployment with tenant id for tracing.

jamie-cs: I'll confirm with the customer and set expectations (we'll monitor telemetry live). Note in CRM: mark renewal as at-risk until post-demo check. Please capture post-demo notes & CSAT.

taylor-cs: Created support task #678901 for pre-demo checklist and post-demo follow-up: connection test, token/latency sanity, fallback plan, CSAT link, schedule 30-min debrief next Tue.

rachel-sre: Adding an alert: infra.alerts/cloudline-demo-latency -> trigger if p50 > 350ms for 5m. Also KV cache hit-rate watch: if <40% we revert override. If sustained tail latencies appear, we'll rollback early.

nate-eng: Alert created (ar-4429). Tracing span keyed to tenant_id for correlation. Will stand by during demo to coordinate rollback if necessary.

jamie-cs: Thanks team. I'll update the ticket with the allowlist rules and the demo schedule. If anything spikes, @rachel-sre & @nate-eng to coordinate rollback. :rocket:

ops-bot: Reminder set: auto-revoke check will notify #customer-success and #eng-sre 30m before 2026-03-25T15:00:00Z.
